trips.route_note: Take a long-distance coach from Cape Town to Hermanus (about 1.5 to 2 hours, with a scenic coastal drive); the town centre and harbour are a short walk or taxi ride from the bus stop.
see: Whale-watching viewpoints (seasonal, roughly June to November)
trips.tour_query: Hermanus whale watching day trip from Cape Town
trips.why: A direct long-distance coach takes you along a scenic coastal drive to a stop within walking distance of the harbour.
know: Whale-watching season is roughly June to November, the best time for this trip.
Check coach timetables in advance, as service frequency may be limited.

trips.route_note: Take a Metrorail train or a long-distance coach from Cape Town to Stellenbosch (about 1 hour), then walk or take a short local taxi into the town centre; check current timetables, as local rail service is often disrupted.
see: Oak-lined town centre and university campus
Local wine estates on the Helshoogte and Simonsberg routes
trips.tour_query: Stellenbosch wine tour day trip from Cape Town
trips.why: The long-distance coach is more dependable than the often-disrupted local rail and drops you near the town centre.
know: Local rail service is often disrupted, so check current timetables before you go.
Many wine estates are spread around the surrounding area, so a short taxi ride between them helps.
